sources.title: GitHub - korda-ai/korda-ai-spec: The Deterministic Autonomous Agent ...
sources.snippet: Korda AI is a formal grammar layer that sits between an AI model and the real world. Instead of letting a model call tools or APIs freely, the model must emit a Korda AI statement. That statement is parsed, permission-checked, and validated before anything executes. Certain actions are structurally impossible to express: exec without a timeout — cannot be written delete-rows without a WHERE ...
